pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Stellate and irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch size is largest on the mid-neck and upper flank, with increasing fragmentation observed towards the ventral and caudal areas.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pixels with clear tri-radiate and quadri-radiate junction nodes. Path thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank but increases significantly in the lower ventral regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dorsal mane displays a serrated 1D profile with moderate frequency and low amplitude. Individual hair tufts are discernible against the background as jagged peaks along the neck line.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A structural break in the continuous mane silhouette is present at the junction of the lower neck and shoulder, coincident with avian perching.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized, dark, textured anomaly with irregular margins and disrupted internal pixel gradients is visible on the lower posterior flank, suggestive of a cutaneous lesion or environmental debris.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, high-contrast avian silhouettes (oxpeckers) perched along the dorsal ridge and lateral neck surface.
